Class BlazeBiteOrders

public class BlazeBiteOrders

Data transfer object for deserializing BlazeBite order documents from Google Firestore. Maps the nested Firestore JSON structure into strongly-typed Apex classes including order details, line items, customizations, checkout totals, and customer contact info.

Group:
    Data Transfer Objects (DTO)

Since:

Version:
